method_limits: One-action contextual bandit, not an autoregressive LM or token-level PPO.
Value target is normalized RM score; KL(policy||fixed SFT) is an explicit analytical policy penalty. OpenAI original token PPO instead includes sampled token KL reward in GAE/returns.
PPO original section 4 KL(old||new) is a per-iteration trust penalty, distinct from DPO section 3's policy-to-fixed-reference penalty.
Squared-error regression estimates a conditional mean only with suitable data and approximation; one sample and gradient direction do not guarantee convergence.
Single-seed deterministic small CPU replay confirms this recipe; measured times are one-run loop/outer timers and omit environment setup. No GPU or general language-quality claim.
